item.description: Michèle Mouton broke through the male-dominated world of rally racing, becoming the first woman to claim victory in a World Rally Championship event. Her impressive skill nearly earned her the world title in 1982, showcasing her talent. Mouton also conquered the famed Pikes Peak International Hill Climb. Her groundbreaking career inspired future female motorsport participants and led her to advocate for women's roles in racing through the FIA commission. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Country loses 200 tennis courts in three years, but they still outnumber padel facilities by a factor of 11 to one England has lost almost 200 tennis courts in three years as padel facilities have grown nearly sixfold. Guardian analysis of Sport England data found that the country has lost 183 tennis courts since 2023 – the first such decline since at least 2000.
